title: Procedural Knowledge Graph & Opslet Generator for Internal Admin Tasks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) service that automatically ingests existing admin runbooks, playbooks, and troubleshooting notes and emits a typed task graph ("opslets") suitable for the runbooks-as-tasks executor. The goal is to accelerate incident remediation and routine admin flows by turning free-form runbook prose into structured, idempotent tasks with preconditions, permissions metadata, and safe-mode fallbacks. This ticket covers the ingestion/normalization pipeline, schema design for opslets, a light-weight validator, and a CLI prototype that can generate a task bundle from a folder of markdown runbooks. The output will be consumable by the existing runbook task runner adapter and the Admin Sandbox for dry-run verification.
acceptance_criteria: PKG service can ingest >= 90% of runbooks in sources/admin-runbooks as-is (markdown + short prose) and produce a task graph without manual tagging
Generated tasks include: step id, description, parameters (typed), preconditions, postconditions, estimated duration, required roles, idempotency hint
CLI prototype (opslet-gen) produces a JSON task bundle; bundle validated by the task schema validator (schema v1) with no errors for 100 example runbooks
Integration smoke test: task bundle can be imported into Admin Sandbox and executed in dry-run mode without side effects and with telemetry emitted to the ops-tooling dashboard (link in comments)
E2E benchmark: average transform time < 2s per 1kB of runbook text on dev laptop spec used in prototype
Documentation: Confluence design doc and a short developer how-to exist and are linked from the ticket
Security review: any task that would require privilege escalation is flagged and gated behind the 'requires-manual-approval' bit in the bundle
